title: German-Style Flatbread with Vegan Pumpernickel Topping
description: A vegan twist on traditional German flatbread, topped with a rich pumpernickel spread.
instructions: 2. In a food processor, combine pumpernickel seeds, black bean paste, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, garlic powder, and salt. Process until smooth.
3. Brush the flatbread with vegan yeast and spread the pumpernickel mixture on top.
4. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the flatbread is crispy and the topping is golden brown.
5. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
